C-ADAPTIVE-ACTION-CENTER-V2.Summary: Corrective superseding revision of the completed Action Center change: repair the GRACE terminal archive gate so a bundle containing Markdown companion artifacts can be moved immutably from active to archive.
C-ADAPTIVE-ACTION-CENTER-V2.Problem: The completed Action Center bundle contains spec.xml, plan.xml, design.md, motion.md and design-audit.md. The current policy requires the archive to preserve this exact five-file set, but archiveCandidate also requires every changed path to be non-governed while isGovernedPath classifies non-XML companions as governed. Moving all five files is therefore rejected before evaluateArchiveTransition can validate them, while moving only XML violates the exact bundle set. The valid terminal transition is mechanically impossible and blocks issue 211 and the next release.

Goals.Goal: Recognize a candidate terminal transition from the matching active and archive C-* paths without requiring Markdown companions to be globally ungoverned.
Keep evaluateArchiveTransition as the authoritative fail-closed validator of allowed paths, exact file set, byte-identical companions, terminal status and absence of an active copy.
Add regression coverage for a valid five-file bundle and for product writes, companion mutation and attempts to rewrite an existing archive.
Document that companion artifacts remain governed during normal implementation and receive a narrow lifecycle exception only inside a validated archive transition.
Complete the correction without changing product behavior, release version, SQLite schema, runtime dependencies or offline assets.

Constraints.Constraint: This approved specification supersedes the previous approved revision of the same active change ID only because the one-active-bundle rule and the broken archive gate make rotation to a new C-* impossible before terminal transition.
The archive exception may apply only when exactly one active C-* and the same one archive C-* are touched, no active bundle remains at HEAD, and an archived spec.xml plus plan.xml exist at HEAD.

All changed paths are still passed to evaluateArchiveTransition; no product, documentation outside the explicitly governed policy note, workflow, migration, graph, context or verification write may be hidden from validation.
Existing archives remain immutable. A branch that only edits an archived bundle must continue to fail.
Normal implementation governance, ObservedWriteScope enforcement and direct XML lifecycle validation must not be weakened.
No release may be published until this correction is merged, post-merge CI is green, and C-ADAPTIVE-ACTION-CENTER-V2 is successfully archived with terminal status applied.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Change Action Center product behavior, document routing, protocol merging or preference ranking.
Broaden lifecycle exceptions to arbitrary files under .grace or to multiple change IDs.
Bypass GRACE checks, merge a failing archive PR or manually modify main.
Change VERSION, schema, migrations, package manifests, release workflows or target deployment behavior.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A repository fixture with approved spec.xml and plan.xml plus design.md, motion.md and design-audit.md can move the exact set from active/C-* to archive/C-* with only root statuses changed to applied.
The same transition fails when any companion artifact changes content.
The same transition fails when an application, workflow, unrelated documentation or other external path is changed in the archive commit.
A direct edit of a C-* that already exists only in archive continues to fail as an immutable archive rewrite.
Implementation PRs still require one approved active bundle and reject every governed path outside ObservedWriteScope.
tests/grace-governance.test.mjs, npm run check, npm run docs:check and the full npm test suite pass.
Exact-head project, GRACE, release, database, browser and full-offline CI are green before squash merge.
After green post-merge CI, a separate archive-only PR for the complete V2 bundle passes and reaches terminal applied state.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Policy regression fixtures prove that Markdown companions are accepted only as part of one exact immutable terminal move, while mutation, outside writes and archive rewrites remain rejected.

Assumptions.Assumption: The verified base is main commit b3ffdd0afb83ece2a640ffd579d870671e5317d3 with tree c9a1061939e1903913320978ed341f0eb4d658e5.
Issue 211 records the blocking lifecycle defect and the required acceptance criteria.
PR 206 product implementation and its post-merge CI are complete; this revision changes only governance required to archive that already merged implementation.
The existing evaluateArchiveTransition function already enforces the required strict path, content and lifecycle invariants once the candidate reaches it.
